name: MPI Parallel Volume Rendering with Distributed k-d Partitioning
definition: A parallel software rendering algorithm for high-accuracy volume rendering using MPI on an IBM SP2. It performs exact analytic or numerical integration for each primary color per pixel, distributed across nodes.
summary: MPI Parallel Volume Rendering with Distributed k-d Partitioning is a software-based algorithm that distributes the entire dataset to all nodes and uses distributed k-d partitioning for load balancing without data movement.
